summary: Tested the clinical-rule engine endpoint + banner end-to-end. Backend rule engine (12 unit tests) and API contract (13 API tests including auth, 404, 403, rule-firing, citation IDs, ordering, empty case) = 25/25 PASS. Frontend banner DOES render correctly when test data is injected: shows 'Clinical Decision Support' eyebrow, top hit title, chip row, evidence take-away. Tapping the banner opens the modal which lists all 4 hits with proper citations + close button works. ONE testability bug found: chip & hit View components use raw `data-testid` prop which React Native Web strips — only the banner (which has both `testID` and `data-testid`) and the close TouchableOpacity (has `testID`) are queryable by automation. Chips (clinical-eval-chip-*) and hits (clinical-eval-hit-{rule_id}) are NOT in the DOM despite rendering visually.

ui_bugs.issue: Inner <View> components use raw JSX prop `data-testid={...}` which React Native Web silently strips. Result: data-testid='clinical-eval-chip-hard|warning|info' and data-testid='clinical-eval-hit-{rule_id}' are NOT present in the rendered DOM. They render visually but are unfindable by automation. Fix: use React Native's `testID={...}` prop (camelCase) on every View — RN Web auto-maps that to data-testid. The banner TouchableOpacity already correctly uses both (testID + data-testid) which is why only it is queryable.

action_items: Add testID prop alongside (or in place of) data-testid on the chip Views (chip-hard / chip-warning / chip-info), each hit View in the modal, and any other inner View that needs to be queryable. Example: <View testID='clinical-eval-chip-hard' data-testid='clinical-eval-chip-hard' ...>. This restores the full data-testid contract promised in the spec.

Full-arch angulation correctly uses inclusive >18 warning / >30 hard_block bounds. Skipped for single-implant procedures (verified).
The component ClinicalEvaluationBanner.tsx is 194 lines, well under the 700-line guideline; clean structure.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint is fully verified — 25 pytest tests pass including auth/role/404/all-rules/ordering. Frontend banner renders and modal opens correctly with all citations (visually confirmed via screenshots). The only outstanding issue is the data-testid contract on inner Views — RN Web only forwards `testID` (camelCase) to the DOM as data-testid; raw `data-testid={...}` JSX props on <View> are stripped. To use Playwright for frontend, you MUST navigate via in-app SPA navigation (window.history.pushState + popstate event) — direct page.goto() wipes the in-memory auth token (web platform uses memoryTokens, not localStorage; see /app/frontend/utils/api.ts lines 11-27).
rca of the issue: RCA — RN Web only translates React Native's `testID` prop (camelCase) into a DOM `data-testid` attribute. When the JSX uses `<View data-testid='...'>` directly, that prop is treated as an unknown DOM-style prop and silently dropped during the RN→DOM bridge. The banner survives because it has BOTH `testID` and `data-testid`; the close button survives because it has `testID`. The chips & hit-cards only declare `data-testid={...}` so they vanish from the DOM. Mitigation: add `testID={...}` to every inner View that needs to be queryable (or replace data-testid with testID — RN Web auto-maps it).
